title: The Battle of Hastings
description: October 1066. William of Normandy's invasion army faces King Harold's Anglo-Saxon shield wall on Senlac Hill. The player commands the Norman force and must break the shield wall through feigned retreats and combined cavalry-archer assaults before nightfall ends the battle.

anachronisms_found: PIKEMAN x16 on the Anglo-Saxon side: the pike square is a 14th-15th century development; the engine already offers SPEARMAN (used here for the fyrd), so massed pikemen for 1066 levies was avoidable
GUARD_TOWER x2 for the Saxons: Harold's host reached Senlac Hill only days before and fought behind a shield wall, not stone fortifications; a Palisade or nothing would have been truer

TOWN_CENTER x1 for each side on the battlefield itself, plus STABLE, ARCHERY_RANGE, BLACKSMITH and BARRACKS: a full economic/production base is out of place for an invasion army camped at Hastings and an Anglo-Saxon field host; only the PAVILION_A/TENT_A camps are appropriate
MONASTERY for Player Two on Senlac Hill: Battle Abbey was founded on the site only after 1070, so a monastery present during the battle is inverted chronology
CROSSBOWMAN x6: Norman crossbows at Hastings are only weakly attested and the AoE2 Crossbowman represents a later, heavier weapon; ARCHER alone would have been safer

4,480 TREE_OAK on a 120x120 map: Senlac was open downland with the ridge as the decisive terrain feature; blanketing the map in oak forest misrepresents the ground on which the cavalry charges and feigned retreats occurred
